item.title: Left-wing host blasts AOC as 'weak,' says she only engages critics who are 100% friendly
item.summary: Ana Kasparian criticized Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for what she called devastating "weakness" on Israel votes during a segment of "The Young Turks" Friday.

item.title: US general warns Russia may be developing nuclear anti-satellite weapon in orbit
item.summary: U.S. Space Command chief says he is very concerned Russia may be developing a nuclear weapon in space that could disrupt satellites and daily life on Earth.

item.title: Peptides may soon be easier to get amid RFK Jr.'s push, but experts warn of risks
item.summary: The FDA is reportedly set to discuss easing peptide restrictions at an anticipated July meeting, as RFK Jr. advocates for making the treatments more accessible.

item.title: NPR gets $80 million gift from Democratic megadonor in major boost after losing government funding
item.summary: NPR says it received $113 million in charitable donations to invest in digital infrastructure after Congress rescinded public media federal funding.

item.title: Daughter of missing American woman touches down in Bahamas, slams stepdad after he fled amid investigation
item.summary: The daughter of missing Bahamas woman Lynette Hooker arrived on Great Abaco Island and lashed out at stepfather Brian Hooker, who left for the U.S. abruptly.

item.title: Tennessee governor signs nuclear family month resolution as critics push back on exclusions
item.summary: Gov. Bill Lee signed a Tennessee resolution making June Nuclear Family Month instead of Pride Month, sparking backlash from LGBTQ+ advocacy groups.

item.title: Hillary Clinton rips Trump on migrant child detentions, but Bill Clinton’s own record cuts deep
item.summary: Hillary Clinton takes aim at Trump immigration policies over ICE child detentions, though thousands of juveniles were detained under Bill Clinton.

item.title: Zendaya's flesh-toned 'Dune' suit divides fans with brutal social media reactions
item.summary: Zendaya, 29, wore a flesh-toned Schiaparelli suit on the "Dune: Part 3" press tour at CinemaCon, and social media had strong opinions about the bold look.

item.title: Former Arsenal goalkeeper Alex Manninger dead at 48 after car struck by train at railroad crossing
item.summary: Former Arsenal goalkeeper Alex Manninger tragically died at 48 after his vehicle was struck by a train at a railroad crossing in Salzburg, Austria, police said.

item.title: Swalwell was dubbed the 'Snapchat king of Congress' years before sexual misconduct scandal emerged
item.summary: Disgraced Democratic Congressman Eric Swalwell was once called the "Snapchat king of Congress" years before his use of the platform was swept up in sexual misconduct allegations.
